classification.difficultyReason: A single interpretive explanation of why an exception to the trend can occur, the same demand as the reference.

content.prompt:
The scatterplot shows the floor area and weekly rent of 10 apartments.

Why might an apartment with a larger floor area have a lower weekly rent than one with a smaller floor area?

answer.short: The larger apartment might be further from the city centre.
answer.worked: Apartments with a larger floor area tend to have a higher weekly rent, but there are exceptions. The larger apartment might be further from the city centre, so its rent can still be lower.
